prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Make an alternative version of the supplied Petani empty-state illustration. Output a 1000 x 1000 PNG with real transparent alpha surrounding the illustration.
PRESERVE the exact friendly farmer character design, relaxed reclined crossed-leg pose, smartphone held in both yellow-gloved hands, straw hat, safety glasses and white mask, green shirt, dark trousers, navy boots, cream pillow, hand-painted cartoon texture, warm color palette and lighting. Head stays toward upper-left and feet toward lower-right/southeast.
ADD a small isometric wall immediately behind the pillow and upper back, so he appears comfortably reclining against a wall with the pillow supporting him. Add a modest patch of floor under his body and boots. Make these a cohesive little isometric vignette, matching the existing elevated three-quarter perspective. Wall in pale warm ivory/sage-gray plaster and floor in muted warm beige, subtle painted texture and gentle contact shadows, low contrast so the farmer remains the focus.
CRITICAL SHAPE: neither the wall silhouette nor the floor footprint should be a perfect rectangle or square. The wall's exposed top edge and exposed side ends have broad, smooth, irregular wave-shaped contours; the floor's entire exposed outer perimeter also has soft undulating organic wavy scallops. Keep the wall itself visibly upright and the floor visibly horizontal, joined by a believable clean wall-floor seam. These are softly waving cutout boundaries, not water waves, not a torn jagged edge, not a perfect rectangular room or thick square platform. Show a little floor beyond the boots and pillow; avoid excessive empty floor or tall scenery.
Entire vignette centered, full character and new wall/floor contained with comfortable transparent margins. No extra props, doors, windows, plants, text, logos, watermarks or opaque full-canvas backdrop. Outside the organically shaped wall/floor vignette is fully transparent.
